quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Yuden press release: Earnings Release Conference for First Quarter of Fiscal (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY3/2027 (results deck): net sales 93.9 billion yen, up 5% QoQ; operating profit 4.8 billion yen, up 39% QoQ, driven by higher capacity utilization from higher sales volumes. Capacitor sales 69,022 million yen, up 7.9% QoQ, driven by IT infrastructure/industrial equipment such as AI servers and by communication equipment; demand expanding for high-value-added, high-end products including those for AI servers. IT infrastructure/industrial equipment plus automotive were 55% of sales; automotive sales declined mainly on sluggish demand in China.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 net sales 93.9 billion yen QoQ +5%; operating profit 4.8 billion yen QoQ +39%; capacitors 69,022 million yen QoQ +7.9%

quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Yuden press release: Earnings Release Conference for First Quarter of Fiscal (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 orders: capacitor orders received expanded 41% QoQ and the capacitor order backlog rose 78%; orders increased across all applications, primarily IT infrastructure/industrial equipment including AI servers and information equipment including memory modules. Book-to-bill rose to 1.72 for capacitors and 1.58 company-wide; company: strong demand continues with the BB ratio significantly exceeding 1.
quarterly_data.figure: capacitor orders +41% QoQ; capacitor backlog +78%; BB 1.72 (capacitors), 1.58 (company-wide)

quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Yuden press release: Earnings Release Conference for First Quarter of Fiscal (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Pricing (company): the pace of like-for-like price decreases improved significantly from the previous quarter and is expected to be more moderate than initially projected; in a tight supply and demand environment the company implemented price revisions for some products, mainly those sold through distributors. Company expects AI server demand to surpass initial expectations, driven by accelerating trends toward higher capacitance and increased unit counts of MLCCs.

quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Yuden press release: Earnings Release Conference for First Quarter of Fiscal (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Revised FY3/2027 forecast by product: capacitors raised 12.2% vs prior forecast (+26% YoY projected), driven by IT infrastructure/industrial equipment, particularly AI servers; inductors 71,500 million yen (+11% YoY), led by information equipment; Others cut to 36,000 million yen mainly because aluminum electrolytic capacitor sales fell short of initial projections. Q2 FY3/2027 outlook QoQ: net sales +15% to +19%, capacitors +16% to +20% (all applications, centered on AI servers and information equipment), inductors +17% to +21% (smartphone seasonality and memory modules), Others +3% to +7%, at 160 yen/US$.
quarterly_data.figure: FY capacitors +26% YoY, inductors +11% YoY; Q2 sales +15%-+19% QoQ, capacitors +16%-+20%
